Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE individual partner character sprite for the Japanese life-simulation game Naotocchi.
Style: charming handcrafted Japanese pixel art, matching polished 128x128 game characters: crisp stepped dark colored outlines, deliberate square pixel clusters, compact limited palette with 2-4 shading tones, warm readable expressive face. Not realistic, smooth vector, painted concept art or glossy 3D. Must still read when reduced to 128x128. One whole body, 3/4 front view slightly facing right unless specified otherwise. Eyes or eyelids AND a clear mouth, with appropriate gentle expression.
Composition: one isolated complete character centered in square canvas. Entire silhouette, every limb, ear, horn, wing, tail, fin and specified prop fully visible, at least 8% empty margin from EVERY image edge. Do not cut off any body part. No additional character, speech bubble, label, letters, numerals, watermark, UI, inset, montage or sprite sheet. No scenery, horizon, floor or cast shadow. Only props expressly specified below.
Background: genuine PNG alpha transparency, also in internal gaps. Never draw a checkerboard. Do not make white body parts transparent.
Subject: An adult elegant female black cat company president, standing upright on two feline paws. Slim charcoal-black fur, small warm ivory muzzle and clear amber eyes with a confident but affectionate half-smile. Wearing a tailored slate-blue business blazer, ivory shirt and straight dark trousers; not a dress or high heels. A small closed plain notebook held under one forearm, the other forepaw casually raised as if leaving work for a date. Both triangular ears, two forepaws, two standing feet and one long curved black tail visible. Clothes and upright stance must distinguish her from an unclothed player cat or a curled-up cat friend. No glasses, text or logos.
